## Highlights since 0.19.0

- **Your Agent conversations come along to the native Lattice.** The native Lattice now shows the Agent conversations you had in the classic version, with their messages and attachments, without anything to do. Each time its Agent starts, it adds the classic version's conversations it doesn't have yet, including ones started there after a switch back, and a short notice says how many. It only reads the classic version's data, never changes it, and leaves the conversations you started in the native Lattice as they are. Continuing an imported conversation picks up from its earlier messages, but not from the tool calls, checkpoints or session the classic version had.
